name: 10025 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10025 (New York) has 572 nonprofit organizations. 224 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 184 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10025 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
